title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments Electric-Field Effects on Laminar Diffusion Flames
objectives: E-FIELD Flames tests how electric forces acting on charged flame species alter non-premixed combustion. Principal phenomena include ion current, field-induced flow, flame geometry, stability and soot behavior.
